settings.title: Project file
settings.description: Path of the .pulse.json that names your engines. Empty: the .pulse.json at the root of the focused workspace.

settings.title: Writes
settings.description: Whether Pulse may retry incidents, change variables, move tokens, cancel and migrate instances.
enumLabels: On engines on this machine only
Also on remote engines with a login

settings.title: Environments
settings.description: Environment of each engine by name, as JSON, e.g. {"prod-eu": "production"}. Loopback hosts are local without configuration.

settings.title: Live updates: local engines
settings.description: Whether open Pulse views read local engines again on their own. Default: on.

settings.title: Live updates: test engines
settings.description: Whether open Pulse views read test engines again on their own. Default: on.

settings.title: Live updates: production engines
settings.description: Whether open Pulse views read production engines again on their own. Default: off.

settings.title: Live updates: unclassified engines
settings.description: Whether open Pulse views read unclassified engines again on their own. Default: off.
